notes:
Summary: Marblegate is a mid-market SaaS vendor (knowledge mgmt for product teams) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Initially testing Hosted API to validate retrieval quality and unit economics; goal is to graduate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and custody of keys.

POC scope (agreed): 2-week Hosted API pilot -> ingest ~500k historical docs via nightly batch + real-time sync for delta updates. Measure: recall@10, MRR, cost per 10k vectors, p95/p99 retrieval latency, tail token latency for generation in assistant flows.

Performance targets / constraints: realtime search 150-250 QPS sustained during business hours, peak spikes to 400 QPS for seasonal campaigns; 95th percentile retrieval latency target <75ms (end-to-end for top-k fetch + re-rank); nightly batch embed job ~1M docs within 6 hours (throughput/cost tradeoff).

Integration notes: Prototype uses Postgres -> ETL -> Pinecone (trial) for vector store. Marblegate engineering wants Redwood to integrate with existing pipeline (exported vectors + bulk upserts) and support direct connector to Pinecone + S3-backed batch ops. They also asked about Milvus self-hosted option for Dedicated.

Model & cost preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified embedding models (lower cost) and tunable quantization profiles for Dedicated. Cost sensitive — CFO asks for modeled unit economics for 12 months before committed capacity. Quote from CTO: "Need predictable unit economics before committing to reserved GPUs."

Security & compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logging, KMS integration for key management, and EU data residency for EU customers. Procurement will require SOC2 + short security FAQ; security team requested a short security review doc and contact.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-01-15: Intro call (Julian P.) — baseline use case, product overview.
- 2026-01-29: Technical deep-dive with SE (Maya C.) — discussed batching, connector, vector DB options. Action: SE to produce connector spec.
- 2026-02-10: Kickoff Hosted API POC (Fireflies ff_2026-02-10_marblegate_poc_k7s9) — ingest plan + metrics sheet shared.
- 2026-02-18: Check-in — early quality results: initial recall good but p95 latency higher than target when re-ranking is enabled. SE recommended prefix caching and aggressive batching for nightly pipelines.

Open questions / blockers: cost model for Dedicated at target QPS, confirmation of VPC peering options for Dedicated, data residency approach for EU workloads (private control plane?), exact SLA for p95 latency.

Next steps (short): pricing scenarios sent by AE, schedule Dedicated sizing call w/ infra & finance, deliver connector spec and batch upsert examples, security FAQ + SOC2 artifacts to security reviewer.
